source: SYNTHESISED from synth-dead-bridge (itself from the real recording ca41ab28-deployed-with-failure, pipeline 2857464986): trigger:website's status set to `created` with its downstream_pipeline still null, and the parent pipeline set to `running`, which is what GitLab reports in the seconds between creating a trigger job and creating its child. Nothing else changed.
note: A trigger job with no child is dead only once it has settled. A `created` trigger has simply not spawned its child yet, and reading it as `dead` turned every push red for its first poll and fired `blocking_failure`. The icon stays `failed` here only because trigger:android's child really did fail.
